summary_markdown:
The conversation shifted to potential improvements for an AI Assistant feature. A proposal was made to eliminate the top menu items, allowing the system to analyze raw text input from the user. Based on this analysis (determining if the user wants filters or a metric query), the chat window would then display actionable buttons leading directly to specific actions, such as navigating to a dashboard with pre-set filters or generating an in-chat graph.

[me] agreed that this approach would be simpler than maintaining complex conversational flows and iterations. The participants decided to pause current tasks so [me] could focus on the AI implementation.
decisions: Explore removing top menu items for AI Assistant input
Use raw text analysis to determine user intent (filters vs. metrics)
Display actionable buttons in chat based on analyzed intent
action_items: [me] will close current tasks and focus on the AI implementation.
